scoreInterpretation: Comparative evidence, not a numerical approval threshold. This round makes substantial style progress, but the profile mouth artifact is a visible blocker.

observations.observation: The original stepped, nearly white toque is replaced by a continuous ivory band and rounded crown. Curls, palms and sleeves have soft native volume; the compact C125 silhouette remains recognizable. The rear curl mass has readable brown value transitions rather than near-black holes.

Lena retains dark-brown skin and chocolate curls, distinct from the warm ivory outfit. The blue apron and red necktie remain clear; the target's lighter orange skin and bright rim were appropriately not copied.

Broad soft illumination retains off-white modeling in the toque and coat without the original white clipping. Four native views remain evenly lit with no preferred horizontal key or directional ground shadow. Silhouettes show clean alpha against all three backgrounds without the target halo.

Shaped collar tabs, cuffs, a larger apron pocket/welt, hem and back knot add useful garment construction. Their positions remain coherent through bent-arm poses. The details are simple at use size, which is appropriate to the small sprite.

The native curved smile floats in front of the head in E/W as a detached black hook. In idle-E frame000 its separate alpha component is at native x271..276/y344..361; W has the symmetric component at x107..112/y344..361. It is visible as a loose dark mark at logical size, most clearly on light/gray backgrounds. The per-object native bounds identify this as chef_lena__R01_gentle_smile, rather than an eye highlight, transparent-edge halo or plate artifact.

All16 clips were played in the local browser at normal rate, with timeline progression and ready video state observed; looping clips continue and the four load clips stop at1s. Frame sheets show the expected breathing/work/hold/load differences without new torso, hat, curl, cuff or apron pops. The detached profile smile remains a persistent construction issue, rather than a momentary motion flicker.

Source and candidate serving contexts preserve the original128px pitch and held-dish action. North-body occlusion is source-consistent. Both source and candidate load end with the dish still held; the separate game-transfer images are illustrations, not native trajectory proof. No new native beltLoad endpoint is required or inferred.

blockers.location: Both profile facings E and W, especially idle/work frames000-011; exposed portions also remain visible above the held dish in hold/load. Native object chef_lena__R01_gentle_smile.
blockers.effect: The smile becomes an isolated dangling black hook beside the face at intended192x320 use size, breaking the clean facial silhouette.
blockers.desiredVisibleOutcome: The friendly frontal smile must sit on and follow the face surface, with a clean natural profile and no detached black mouth stroke in either side facing throughout all actions. Preserve the native face identity, rig, motion and capture contract; choose the native construction method freely.

remainingDifferences: The rounded toque is simpler and puffier than the target's elongated folded fabric crown. Its band and crown remain readable; exact target folds and lobe count are not required.

Curls remain grouped into chunky stylized locks, with a more regular rear rhythm than the target front exploration. The native rear has sufficient soft volume and separation at intended size; the single front target does not dictate an unseen back.
Garment forms and highlights remain simpler and more matte than the target. The candidate avoids target glare/rim artifacts and retains the compact body/minimal foot envelope.
Natural north-facing hand/dish occlusion and the hold-like native load endpoint match the untouched source behavior and are accepted.
